files.patch:
@@ -1,14 +1,15 @@
 name: CI
 
-# push covers the actual default branch (this repository's default is the
-# long-lived claude/arq-cad-platform-research-ba8rav branch, not main);
+# During ADR-0029's reversible branch migration, pushes to both the current
+# integration branch and the future `main` branch must receive the same CI.
+# Keep both until `main` is the verified default and the rollback window closes.
 # merge_group is present so a merge queue can be enabled later without a
 # coverage gap — see engineering/33_IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md Phase 2.
 on:
   pull_request:
   merge_group:
   push:
-    branches: [claude/arq-cad-platform-research-ba8rav]
+    branches: [claude/arq-cad-platform-research-ba8rav, main]
 
 # This is the expensive workflow - eleven headless-Chromium capability checks,
 # the full test suite and the language ladder - and without a concurrency group

@@ -8,9 +8,9 @@
 # SITE_ORIGIN enables sitemap.xml, the robots Sitemap line and absolute
 # Open Graph URLs.
 #
-# Triggers: pushes that touch the site on the default branch, plus manual
-# dispatch. (The in-flight site branch triggers were trimmed after PRs #282
-# and #283 merged, as their own comments instructed.)
+# Triggers: pushes that touch the site on either branch participating in the
+# ADR-0029 migration, plus manual dispatch. Keeping both branch triggers during
+# the rollback window prevents the deployment path from disappearing mid-cutover.
 #
 # Language System 4.1 adds three gates around the existing build: route
 # coverage before the build, a rendered-copy audit that writes a commit-bound
@@ -25,6 +25,7 @@ on:
   push:
     branches:
       - claude/arq-cad-platform-research-ba8rav
+      - main
     paths:
       - 'apps/marketing/**'
       - 'brand/**'
